items.text: Ver. 1.0.18 Bug Fixes & Updates
1. Fixed an issue where abnormal adventurer states could cause all adventurers on screen to become stuck.
2. Fixed an issue where weather events caused abnormal tile occupation on the map.
3. Fixed an issue where PuPus participating in research at the Tower of Union could be mistakenly selected for automation.
4. Fixed an issue where selecting PuPus in the Tower of Courage could cause them to become stuck.
5. Fixed an issue where, after a hero level-up popup appeared while the camera was in the PuPu Nest, the park menu was displayed inside the nest view.
6. Fixed an issue where the park’s bottom menu occasionally disappeared under certain conditions.
7. Added instruction manual entries related to the Tower of Union.
8. Fixed an issue where, in non-Simplified Chinese languages, certain hero commissions could not be dispatched properly.
9. Added local save version detection — if the configuration file format is incorrect, it will now be automatically cleared.
(This primarily affects local config files from Demo or early versions, preventing related gameplay errors.)
10. Added corrupted save file detection to prevent data loss caused by faulty save operations.
11. Added missing localization for some text content.
(Some late-game and Tower of Union content is still being localized and will be completed in the next update.)
12. Added a new button to the bottom of park building and adventurer interfaces.
🧩 About the New “Unstuck” Function
When adventurers become motionless inside a building or stand idle in the park,
you can now click on the adventurer/building interface.
The game will attempt to clear abnormal data and teleport the stuck adventurer back to the Summoning Circle.
⚠ Note: The feature does not apply to cases where an adventurer or hero is immobile due to missing road tiles.
If this happens, please try adding road tiles beneath their feet — they will then be able to leave the park or return to their tent/inn normally.
If you still encounter stuck adventurers, please upload your affected save through the in-game feedback system.
This helps us reproduce and resolve the issue more efficiently.
Fixed an issue where abnormal Illusion Building data caused save files to fail to load for some players.
Fixed an issue where a PuPu recovering mood inside a transforming building could enter an exclusive dormitory and cause abnormal PuPu states.
Fixed an issue where certain operations on the new map incorrectly displayed tutorial prompts when the tutorial had not been skipped.
1. Fixed an issue where opening the PuPu List in certain save files caused abnormal error messages.
2. Fixed an issue where a newly bred PuPu was incorrectly set to Level 1.
3. Fixed an issue where opening the Illusion Building – Hot Spring displayed abnormal information in some save files.
Additionally, we are currently testing fixes for issues such as rooms freezing, adventurers becoming stuck, and PuPu disappearing or duplicating in the Playtest branch.
Because these involve significant logic adjustments, the fixes are still under testing and will be released to the main branch once the version is confirmed to be stable.
Fixed an issue where the game could pause abnormally when the Diligence Tower’s exclusive room had no selected work type.
Fixed an issue where a PuPu removed from automation in the Diligence Tower’s exclusive room could still be mistakenly managed for work after becoming an Emissary.
Fixed an issue where newly bred PuPus from the Fountain did not correctly inherit the current level attributes after obtaining a gem for the first time.
Added logical safeguards for certain cases where saving was impossible — restarting the game will now allow saving again, preventing save loss.
Added logic protection for abnormal room interactions occurring after loading a save.
Fixed an issue where pop-up windows appearing during building placement caused construction state errors.
Fixed an issue where some players received a “Save File Corrupted” message after loading and then saving their game.
Since some fixes involves several logic adjustments, we are currently testing the adventurer stuck in room and missing PuPu in room issues on the Playtest branch.
Once the build proves stable, it will be merged into the main (public) branch.

items.text: [Game Adjustments]
· The Goblin Shop now includes Max and Min quantity buttons for more convenient shopping.
· Adjusted the overhead prompts for Heroes in different adventure states.
· Optimized the hero queue for multiple hot springs, now heroes will prefer to go to the hot spring with a shorter queue.
· Optimized the bubble display for building technologies; now, when activating a duplicate technology, a cycle technology bubble will be shown.
· Adjusted the unlocking sequence of certain hero identity wishes.
· Optimized the interface display when upgrading hero identities; you can now navigate to wish adjustments directly from the upgrade interface.
· Optimized the hero information panel; the smiley face count will now be shown when pointing at the satisfaction display position.
· Optimized the hero adventure path panel; when storylines have limited-time sale items, they will be displayed separately.
[Bug Fixes]
· Fixed an issue where some older save files caused the game to freeze when heroes left a room.
· Fixed a bug where dispatching Kexin after unlocking the Grassland Hero Inn caused a game error.
· Fixed an issue where after completing an inn dispatch commission, other commissions could not be completed when returning to the inn.
· Fixed a bug where the prompt still appeared when repeating the commission after unlocking Hero Biography 1’s skill.
· Fixed an issue where heroes summoned by the summoning circle sometimes lacked a jump animation.
· Fixed an error in the text display when triggering stamina recovery in the hero adventure log.
· Fixed an issue where hero commission count wasn't correctly displayed in some cases.
· Fixed an issue where the hero's patrol route lacked punctuation at the turn points.
· Fixed missing translations for some text in the hero patrol interface in other languages.
· Fixed an issue with some panels being clickable through.
